slides.texte_overlay:
as someone with ADHD,
these 5 tiny things make
cleaning actually possible

1. one category at a time

not "clean the room".
just "everything that's clothes".
then "everything that's trash"

2. the "i don't know" basket

anything i can't decide on
goes in one basket.
the room is done, the basket waits

3. clean while the kettle boils

one surface per kettle.
small, but it adds up
over a whole day

4. the 10 minute promise

i only promise 10 minutes.
half the time i keep going.
the other half, i still did 10

5. done beats perfect

a tidy-ish room is so much better
than waiting for the perfect
cleaning day that never comes

follow, i post what
actually works for my brain
